en: A black and white photograph showing a central European city square with a large domed building in the foreground (right side), likely a former mosque, surrounded by a curved road and small park. To the left, a long, classical-style building with many windows is present. In the background, a cathedral with four distinctive towers rises above the city, with hills visible further back.
